children: Japanese stocks are lower as concerns about the Iran conflict and higher energy costs resurface. Chip stocks are leading declines. Tokyo Electron Ltd. is down 4.1%, Renesas Electronics is 3.0% lower and Lasertec is down 3.1%. The dollar is at 159.74 yen, compared with Y159.86 as of Monday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are closely watching any developments in the Middle East and crude oil prices. The Nikkei Stock Average is down 1.0% at 65646.57. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
